The American pope greeted the flag-waving, cheering throngs from his popemobile during a 2-kilometer (1.2-mile) parade […]

Actual Article Body:
PARIS (AP) — Hundreds of thousands of people packed Paris’ iconic Champs-Élysées avenue for Pope Leo XIV’s big outdoor Mass on Saturday, a sign of the Catholic Church’s enduring appeal in the once staunchly Catholic but officially secular country.

The American pope greeted the flag-waving, cheering throngs from his popemobile during a 2-kilometer (1.2-mile) parade along the grand boulevard leading to the Place de la Concorde for Mass, essentially the heart of Paris and a symbol of the French republic.

Thousands without power, roads flood in New Jersey as first major signs of nor’easter take shape

Tens of millions of people are in the path of the storm already beginning to lash the region with strong winds and rain.

Actual Article Body:
Switch between CA and NY editions here.

See more of our coverage in your search results.

Thousands were plunged into darkness as the initial wall of a severe Nor’easter crashed into the East Coast — with millions of people in the path of the intense storm barreling towards the region early Saturday morning.

Nearly 30,000 customers in New Jersey were left without power as of 7 a.m. on Saturday, with most blackouts centered around Cumberland, Monmouth and Ocean Counties, according to tracker PowerOutage.us.

Roughly 22,000 New Yorkers were in the dark —, 11,000 of whom live in Suffolk County and another 4,000 each in Nassau County and Queens.

The rapidly strengthening nor’easter is expected to create dangerous conditions with heavy rain and high winds across the large region spanning New England to Long Island, New York City, New Jersey and southern Delaware.
